scenarios.name: only an adult can change or remove a medication; a child cannot edit even their own

steps.sql: INSERT INTO app_medication_tracker__medications (id, member_id, name, dosage, reminder_times, created_at) VALUES ('m1', ?, 'Amoxicillin', '250mg', '["08:00","20:00"]', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')
UPDATE app_medication_tracker__medications SET archived = 1 WHERE id = 'm1'
DELETE FROM app_medication_tracker__medications WHERE id = 'm1'
SELECT id, archived FROM app_medication_tracker__medications
UPDATE app_medication_tracker__medications SET archived = 1 WHERE id = 'm1'
SELECT id, archived FROM app_medication_tracker__medications
